441089440.name: Treeline Camo Trucker
441089440.description: A low-profile six-panel trucker in olive camo with a breathable mesh back and a pre-curved visor. The EVOLVE crest is embroidered on the front — made for the long drive to where the trees take over.

441089080.name: Longhaul Hoodie
441089080.description: A premium midweight pullover that settles in like a second skin on a cold morning. The EVOLVE wordmark is embroidered, tonal and clean — built for the bush, made for the long haul.

441087767.name: Coldfront Long-Sleeve
441087767.description: A Champion long-sleeve in clean white with the EVOLVE crest embroidered at the chest. The first layer on a coldfront morning — soft, durable, and quietly proud.

441087198.name: Driftwood Hooded Long-Sleeve
441087198.description: A charcoal-black triblend hooded long-sleeve that drapes light and wears warm. The EVOLVE mark is embroidered — equal parts trail layer and town layer.

441085408.name: Summit Full-Zip
441085408.description: A heavyweight full-zip in charcoal heather with a structured hood and a weight that holds the cold off. EVOLVE embroidered at the chest — zip up and head higher.

441085023.name: Heritage Classic Tee
441085023.description: A heavy-cotton classic tee in natural, cut for everyday wear and embroidered with the EVOLVE crest. Plain, honest, and built to outlast the season.

441084646.name: Deepwoods Heavyweight Hoodie
441084646.description: A 10oz heavyweight pullover in army green — the anchor of the range. The EVOLVE crest sits embroidered and tonal, weighted to outlive the winters that made us.

441084360.name: Nightfall Snapback
441084360.description: A structured premium snapback in heather grey with a flat brim and a clean adjustable snap. EVOLVE embroidered up front — for everyone at camp.

441084054.name: Whiteout Organic Cap
441084054.description: An organic-cotton baseball cap in black with a relaxed unstructured fit and a curved brim. The EVOLVE crest is embroidered in white — earned outside, easy on the planet.

441083649.name: Ridgeline Snapback
441083649.description: The structured premium snapback in dark grey, flat-brimmed and clean. EVOLVE embroidered on the front panel — built for the bush and the long road home.

441082795.name: Stormcheck Packable Anorak
441082795.description: A Champion packable anorak that folds into its own pocket and opens up into real wind cover. EVOLVE embroidered at the chest — for when the weather doesn't ask permission.

441082547.name: Backcountry Trucker
441082547.description: The classic Richardson 112 trucker in loden with a structured front and breathable mesh back. EVOLVE embroidered up front — the cap you reach for first.

441082269.name: Outpost Ringer Tee
441082269.description: A cotton ringer tee in heather grey with black trim and the EVOLVE crest embroidered at the chest. Retro lines, backcountry heart.

440709618.name: Wildmark Organic Tee
440709618.description: A Stanley/Stella organic-cotton crafter tee in desert dust, soft and substantial. The EVOLVE crest is embroidered — quiet, earthy, and earned outside.

440708831.name: Trailhead Tank
440708831.description: A jersey tank in black, cut clean for hot climbs and long days. The EVOLVE artwork is printed at the chest — the lightest layer in the kit.

440708024.name: Whitewood Snapback
440708024.description: A pro-style six-panel snapback in white with a structured front and flat brim. EVOLVE embroidered up front — clean lines, cold country.

440613219.name: Frontier Trucker
440613219.description: The Richardson 112 trucker in loden — structured front, mesh back, pre-curved visor. EVOLVE embroidered on the panel, made for the long haul.

440612780.name: Boreal Pullover Hoodie
440612780.description: The premium pullover in black with a double-lined hood and a heavy, settled drape. EVOLVE embroidered tonal at the chest — the everyday anchor.

440612001.name: Whiteout V-Neck
440612001.description: A soft jersey v-neck in black with the EVOLVE crest embroidered in white at the chest. Simple, sharp, and built to be worn down.

440610853.name: Woodsmoke Crewneck
440610853.description: A premium crew-neck sweatshirt in black with a clean set-in sleeve and a brushed-soft inside. EVOLVE embroidered tonal — for the cool end of the day.

440610516.name: Blackout Hoodie
440610516.description: A heavy-blend hoodie in black with the EVOLVE crest embroidered dark-on-dark. Understated, durable, and made to disappear into the night.

440609882.name: Anvil Heavyweight Tee
440609882.description: A men's heavyweight tee in black with a structured body that holds its shape. EVOLVE embroidered at the chest — the tee you reach for and never question.

440609698.name: Trapline Heavyweight Hoodie
440609698.description: An oversized heavyweight hoodie in black, dropped-shoulder and built like armour. The EVOLVE crest is embroidered — for the coldest mornings and the longest hauls.

440609155.name: Halfday Raglan
440609155.description: A fine-jersey raglan in heather denim and navy with classic three-quarter sleeves. The EVOLVE crest is embroidered at the chest — easy days, big country.

440608834.name: Northcut V-Neck
440608834.description: A soft jersey v-neck in dark grey heather with the EVOLVE crest embroidered clean at the chest. A quiet staple for everywhere the week takes you.

440607891.name: Great White North Tumbler
440607891.description: A 20oz insulated stainless tumbler that keeps the coffee hot to the trailhead and the water cold on the way back. The EVOLVE design is printed wrap-around — built for the long haul.

440607292.name: Stealth Snapback
440607292.description: The premium structured snapback in all black with a flat brim and a clean snap. EVOLVE embroidered tonal up front — stealth-fit, weather-tested.

440606458.name: Stealth Dad Cap
440606458.description: A low-profile six-panel dad hat in black with an unstructured fit and a curved brim. The EVOLVE crest is embroidered — easy, broken-in, everyday.

440605056.name: Wanderlust Cuff Beanie
440605056.description: A tight ribbed cuff beanie in dark grey that holds heat without the itch. EVOLVE embroidered on a woven-clean cuff — for the cold end of every season.

440601843.name: Borealis Camp Mug
440601843.description: A 15oz glossy black ceramic mug with the EVOLVE borealis design printed wrap-around. Coffee before the cold, cocoa after — the one that lives at camp.

440600277.name: Stealth Full-Zip
440600277.description: The heavyweight full-zip in all black with a structured hood and a real, settled weight. EVOLVE embroidered tonal at the chest — zip up and vanish into the dark.

440597762.name: Hearth Fleece Zip
440597762.description: A midweight zip hood in charcoal heather with a brushed-soft fleece inside. The EVOLVE crest is embroidered at the chest — the layer you live in by the fire.
